steps.name: Environment setup and verification
steps.description: Verify node >=16 and npm are available, choose package manager by lockfile in the workspace, and persist headless environment variables (CI=true, BROWSER=none) idempotently in /etc/profile.d/node_headless.sh so future shells inherit them. This step does not reinstall preinstalled tools in the image and uses the authoritative workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/saqiba/Desktop/test_rle/workspace/tmp/kavia/code-generation/responsive-food-explorer-237698-237712/backend}"
NODE_BIN="$(command -v node || true)"; NPM_BIN="$(command -v npm || true)"; YARN_BIN="$(command -v yarn || true)"
if [ -z "${NODE_BIN}" ] || [ -z "${NPM_BIN}" ]; then echo "Error: node or npm not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; fi
NODE_VER_RAW=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//'); NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "${NODE_VER_RAW}" | cut -d. -f1)
NPM_VER_RAW=$(npm -v || echo "0")
echo "node=${NODE_VER_RAW} npm=${NPM_VER_RAW}"
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:=0}" -lt 16 ]; then echo "Error: node >=16 required, found ${NODE_VER_RAW}" >&2; exit 3; fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# choose package manager by lockfile (printed for downstream scripts)
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then echo "Warning: both yarn.lock and package-lock.json present; preferring yarn" >&2; echo "PACKAGE_MANAGER=yarn"; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then echo "PACKAGE_MANAGER=yarn"; else echo "PACKAGE_MANAGER=npm"; fi
# idempotent /etc/profile.d entry (persist headless vars)
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/node_headless.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# persisted by env-setup-001: headless node environment
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
# keep $HOME literal so it expands per-user
if [ -d /usr/local/bin ]; then PATH_ADD="/usr/local/bin"; fi
if [ -d "$HOME/.npm-global/bin" ]; then PATH_ADD="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:${PATH_ADD:-}"; fi
if [ -n "${PATH_ADD:-}" ]; then export PATH="$PATH_ADD:$PATH"; fi
EOF
sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PROFILE")"
sudo bash -c "[ -f '$PROFILE' ] && cmp -s '$TMP' '$PROFILE' && rm -f '$TMP' || (cat '$TMP' > '$PROFILE' && rm -f '$TMP')"
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE" || true

steps.name: Install project dependencies deterministically
steps.description: Install project dependencies in the workspace using the selected package manager. If yarn.lock exists use yarn (immutable), otherwise use npm and prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists. This step uses the workspace path and will fail fast on install errors.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/saqiba/Desktop/test_rle/workspace/tmp/kavia/code-generation/responsive-food-explorer-237698-237712/backend}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json not found" >&2; exit 2; fi
PM="npm"
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PM="yarn"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then echo "Warning: both yarn.lock and package-lock.json present; preferring yarn" >&2; PM="yarn"; fi
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent; fi
else
  if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --immutable --silent || yarn install --silent; else yarn install --silent; fi
  else
    echo "yarn not available, falling back to npm" >&2; npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent
  fi
fi
# verify node_modules exists
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo "install failed: node_modules missing" >&2; exit 3; fi
# print core package versions if present
for pkg in react react-dom vite; do
  if [ -f "node_modules/$pkg/package.json" ]; then node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/$pkg/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/saqiba/Desktop/test_rle/workspace/tmp/kavia/code-generation/responsive-food-explorer-237698-237712/backend}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"

# Persist headless env vars idempotently for future shells

TMP_FILE="/tmp/node_headless.sh.$$"
cat >"$TMP_FILE" <<'EOF'
# headless node environment for CI and to prevent browsers opening
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
EOF
if [ ! -f "$PROFILE_FILE" ] || ! cmp -s "$TMP_FILE" "$PROFILE_FILE"; then
  sudo mv "$TMP_FILE" "$PROFILE_FILE"
  sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
else
  rm -f "$TMP_FILE"
fi

# verify node >=16 and npm available
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "node not found" >&2; exit 10; fi
NODE_VERSION=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_VERSION%%.*}
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "node >=16 required, found $NODE_VERSION" >&2; exit 11; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 12; fi

# ensure package.json exists
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json not found" >&2; exit 2; fi

# choose package manager based on lockfiles
PM="npm"
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PM="yarn"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then echo "Warning: both yarn.lock and package-lock.json present; preferring yarn" >&2; PM="yarn"; fi

# run deterministic install
if [ "$PM" = "npm" ]; then
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
    npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent
  else
    npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent
  fi
else
  if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
      # try immutable install first, fall back to normal install if immutable fails
      yarn install --immutable --silent || yarn install --silent
    else
      yarn install --silent
    fi
  else
    echo "yarn not available, falling back to npm" >&2
    npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent
  fi
fi

# verify node_modules exists
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo "install failed: node_modules missing" >&2; exit 3; fi

# print core package versions if present
for pkg in react react-dom vite; do
  if [ -f "node_modules/$pkg/package.json" ]; then
    node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/$pkg/package.json').version)}catch(e){}" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
done

steps.description: Build the project (npm run build or yarn build) with CI and NODE_ENV=production, serve the production output deterministically and verify an HTTP response on VALIDATION_PORT (default 3000). Starts servers in a way that can be reliably killed (setsid/process group) and falls back to a single-PID Node static server when necessary. Uses the workspace path for all operations.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/saqiba/Desktop/test_rle/workspace/tmp/kavia/code-generation/responsive-food-explorer-237698-237712/backend}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export CI=true
export BROWSER=none
PORT="${VALIDATION_PORT:-3000}"
export PORT
# build
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json missing" >&2; exit 2; fi
export NODE_ENV=production
export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn build --silent; else npm run build --silent; fi
# find build output
OUT_DIR="dist"
if [ ! -d "$OUT_DIR" ]; then if [ -d build ]; then OUT_DIR=build; else echo "build output not found (dist or build)" >&2; exit 3; fi; fi
LOGFILE=/tmp/validation_server.log
# start server deterministically
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then
  setsid ./node_modules/.bin/serve -s "$OUT_DIR" -l "$PORT" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
elif [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then
  setsid ./node_modules/.bin/vite preview --port "$PORT" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
else
  # single-PID deterministic static server fallback
  setsid node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir=process.argv[1]||'dist';const port=+process.env.PORT||3000;const srv=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=path.join(dir,req.url==='/'?'/index.html':req.url);fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.statusCode=404;res.end('not found');}else{res.end(d);}})});srv.listen(port,()=>console.log('static-server',process.pid));" "$OUT_DIR" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
fi
trap 'if [ -n "${PGID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
# wait for server
for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; if curl -sS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then echo "server did not start; log:" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOGFILE" >&2 || true; exit 4; fi; done
# capture response evidence
curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" | head -c 200 > /tmp/validation_response.html || true
sed -n '1,5p' /tmp/validation_response.html || true

  setsid ./node_modules/.bin/serve -s "$OUT_DIR" -l "$PORT" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
elif [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then
  setsid ./node_modules/.bin/vite preview --port "$PORT" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
else
  setsid node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir=process.argv[1]||'dist';const port=+process.env.PORT||3000;const srv=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let url=req.url.split('?')[0];let p=path.join(dir,url==='/'?'/index.html':url);fs.readFile(p,(e,d)=>{if(e){res.statusCode=404;res.end('not found');}else{res.end(d);}})});srv.listen(port,()=>console.log('static-server',process.pid));" "$OUT_DIR" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
  PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
fi
# persist PID/PGID for stop
echo "$PID" >/tmp/validation_server.pid
echo "$PGID" >/tmp/validation_server.pgid
# wait for server to respond
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  sleep 1
  if curl -sS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
    echo "server did not start; log:" >&2
    sed -n '1,200p' "$LOGFILE" >&2 || true
    exit 6
  fi
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# stop server started by .init/start.sh
PGID_FILE=/tmp/validation_server.pgid
PID_FILE=/tmp/validation_server.pid
if [ -f "$PGID_FILE" ]; then
  PGID=$(cat "$PGID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
    kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi
rm -f /tmp/validation_server.pid /tmp/validation_server.pgid || true
